ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil 'IFM' snapshot on domain controllers
ucs.description: Detects the exact ntdsutil command chain Volt Typhoon (a.k.a. Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE / BRONZE SILHOUETTE) uses in CISA AA24-038A to dump Active Directory's NTDS.dit + SYSTEM hive to a staging directory ('activate instance ntds' + 'ifm' + 'create full <path>'). This LOLBIN-only credential-access pivot is on every Volt Typhoon intrusion in CISA/NSA/FBI reporting and is rarely run by legitimate admins outside disaster-recovery rehearsals.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe (Processes.process="*ifm*" Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("ifm", "create full")
   or ProcessCommandLine has "ac i ntds"
   or ProcessCommandLine has "activate instance ntds"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
| where CommandLine has_all ("ifm", "create full")
   or CommandLine has "ac i ntds"
   or CommandLine has "activate instance ntds"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Theft via ntdsutil IFM Snapshot
id: 8a4c2f7b-9d12-4b3e-9f0a-3e2c1f6e9a7d
status: experimental
description: Detects ntdsutil being used with 'IFM' / 'create full' / 'activate instance ntds' arguments — the specific NTDS.dit extraction chain attributed to Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda) in CISA AA24-038A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_args:
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'ifm'
        - 'create full'
    - CommandLine|contains: 'ac i ntds'
    - CommandLine|contains: 'activate instance ntds'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and selection_args and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Authorized AD disaster-recovery / IFM media creation by domain admins
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUtil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE) (@CommandLine:(*ifm* AND *"create full"*) OR @CommandLine:*"ac i ntds"* OR @CommandLine:*"activate instance ntds"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(ifm.*create\s+full|ac\s+i\s+ntds|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The ntdsutil 'ac i ntds' + 'ifm' + 'create full' chain is the verbatim DC-credential-dump procedure Volt Typhoon used at the US Pacific water utility and the Guam communications intrusion (per CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft MERCURY/VOLTZITE writeups). Because Volt Typhoon's signature is strict LOTL — no Mimikatz, no custom droppers — high-signal hooks are necessarily on these built-in administrative

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon LOTL discovery burst — multiple host-recon LOLBins from one parent within minutes
ucs.description: Volt Typhoon's hands-on-keyboard reconnaissance signature is a fast burst of built-in Windows discovery commands (whoami, ipconfig /all, netstat -ano, net user/group, systeminfo, tasklist /v, nltest, quser, route print, arp -a, query user, wmic) spawned by a single cmd.exe / PowerShell parent within a few minutes. CISA, Microsoft, and CrowdStrike (Vanguard Panda) reporting all flag this exact post-edge-device-compromise enumeration burst as the actor's tradecraft fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands dc(Processes.process_name) as tool_count values(Processes.process_name) as tools from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN (whoami.exe, ipconfig.exe, netstat.exe, net.exe, net1.exe, systeminfo.exe, tasklist.exe, quser.exe, nltest.exe, arp.exe, route.exe, query.exe, wmic.exe, hostname.exe) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where tool_count >= 5 AND NOT match(user, "\$$") AND match(parent_process_name, "(?i)(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wmiprvse|services)\.exe") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","nltest.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","query.exe","wmic.exe","hostname.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmiprvse.exe","services.exe","explorer.exe")
| summarize Distinct = dcount(FileName),
            Tools    = make_set(FileName, 32),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 32)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 5m)
| where Distinct >= 5
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","nltest.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","query.exe","wmic.exe","hostname.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Binary = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentBinary = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Binary in (ReconBins)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentBinary in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmiprvse.exe","services.exe","explorer.exe")
| summarize Distinct = dcount(Binary),
            Tools    = make_set(Binary, 32),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 32)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, ProcessId, ParentBinary,
               Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Distinct >= 5
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query:
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wmiprvse.exe OR *\WmiPrvSE.exe) @Image:(*\whoami.exe OR *\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\ipconfig.exe OR *\IPCONFIG.EXE OR *
etstat.exe OR *\NETSTAT.EXE OR *
et.exe OR *\NET.EXE OR *
et1.exe OR *\NET1.EXE OR *\systeminfo.exe OR *\SYSTEMINFO.EXE OR *	asklist.exe OR *\TASKLIST.EXE OR *\quser.exe OR *\QUSER.EXE OR *
ltest.exe OR *\NLTEST.EXE OR *\arp.exe OR *\ARP.EXE OR *oute.exe OR *\ROUTE.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE OR *\hostname.exe OR *\HOSTNAME.EXE) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(whoami|ipconfig|netstat|net1?|systeminfo|tasklist|quser|nltest|arp|route|query|wmic|hostname)\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wmiprvse|services|explorer)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, bin(_time, 5m)], function={count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=tool_count) | collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine])})
| tool_count >= 5
ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon's intrusions are uniquely characterised by LOTL-only post-exploitation — no implants, no Mimikatz, no Cobalt Strike. Microsoft's May 2023 Volt Typhoon advisory and CISA AA24-038A both publish almost identical recon-command lists run within the same logon session, often invoked from a single cmd.exe spawned by w3wp.exe or a webshell on a public-facing Fortinet/Ivanti/NetScaler applianc
